newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-JORDAN AND BENETTON FIGHT FOR FISICHELLA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-JORDAN AND BENETTON FIGHT FOR FISICHELLA.

text.p: Jordan Grand Prix team owner Eddie Jordan on Tuesday challenged Benetton's bid to sign Italian Giancarlo Fisichella for next season.
Speaking on BBC radio, Jordan said he had not yet agreed to releasing Fisichella and raised the prospect of a behind-the-scenes battle for his services.
Fisichella, 24, has established himself as one of the brightest prospects in the sport this season and Benetton on July 22 announced he would be driving for them.
Benetton managing director Flavio Briatore, who is also Fisichella's manager, is understood to have signed him for Benetton and then loaned him to Jordan.
Benetton said last month: "We have been impressed by his performance and had no hesitation in exercising our option so that he can drive for us next year."
Fisichella, 24, begins testing the 1998-specification Jordan car at Silverstone on Thursday unsure whether he will still be with the Silverstone-based team next year.
But Jordan made it clear that was not the case.
"This all happened while I was on holiday in Sardinia and I knew absolutely nothing about it until someone sent me a copy of the Benetton press release," he said.
"I found the whole thing very strange. All I can say is that such an announcement is very premature and we intend to honour the confidentiality aspect of our agreement with Fisichella."
The Italian qualified second at Hockenheim last month following the Benetton announcement -- his best grid position -- and fought for the lead before suffering a puncture.
Fisichella's career has been guided by Briatore, who helped him get a part-time drive with Minardi in 1996 before Jordan. Fisichella has not commented on the struggle for his services.
But a Benetton official was adamant on Tuesday, saying: "As far as we are concerned, he will be driving for Benetton."
